title: Binciken, farashi lafiya da jagora: UX azaman sabis na ƙwararru

say: Binciken, farashi lafiya da jagora: UX azaman sabis na ƙwararru.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don samfuri uku na UX Design Tushen: shawarwari, jagoranci da babban fayil.

Binciken UX nazari ne da aka mayar da hankali wanda ke gano matsalolin amfani da ke kashe kasuwanci mafi yawa, kuma yana ba da shawarar gyara cikin tsari. Yana da iyaka a sarari, da sauri don bayarwa, kuma sau da yawa yana haifar da sake fasalin aiki.

say: Yi hira da wanda ya kafa, manajan samfur, mai haɓakawa da goyon bayan abokin ciniki, na tsawon mintuna 30 zuwa 45 kowanne.
Da farko tambaya: idan wannan binciken ya yi nasara, wace lamba ke motsawa?

panel.heading: Tambayi kafin ku taɓa samfurin
items: Sakamakon: wanne lamba ya kamata ya motsa?
Masu amfani: na'urori, cibiyoyin sadarwa, harsuna
Shaida: nazari, sake dubawa, rajistan ayyukan tallafi
San ciwon da aka sani: manyan tikitin tallafi guda biyar
Matsaloli da masu yanke shawara

say: Tambayi su waye masu amfani, akan waɗanne na'urori da cibiyoyin sadarwa. Tambayi menene nazari, bita da rajistan ayyukan tallafi, kuma nemi damar mai kallo.

say: Ba kowace rana ba ce ta biya. Adadin ku dole ne ya cika burin samun kuɗin shiga tare da farashin kasuwanci. Alkaluman Bisi suna misaltawa kuma kusani ne.

card.title: Daga burin samun shiga zuwa farashin duba
card.note: Ƙididdiga na Naira suna kwatantawa kuma kusan.

say: Manufar samun kudin shiga ita ce Naira miliyan 9,600, tare da 1,200,000 na farashin kayan aiki, bayanai da wutar lantarki. Wannan ya sa 10,800,000.

card.title: Daga burin samun shiga zuwa farashin duba

say: A karkashin Dokar Kariyar Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023, rikodin, sunaye, lambobin waya da ra'ayoyin bayanan sirri ne. Yi amfani da fom ɗin yarda na yare bayyananne wanda ke faɗin abin da aka yi rikodi, me yasa, da tsawon lokacin.

Adana amintacce; share a ranar kwangilar

say: Lakabi mahalarta P1, P2 a cikin bayanin kula, kuma adana jerin suna a cikin keɓe, fayil mai kariya ta kalmar sirri.

panel.rule: Rikodi bayanan sirri ne. Share su akan ranar da aka amince.

say: Kar a fara aiki ba tare da ajiyar kuɗin da aka amince ba. Yi hankali da abokan ciniki waɗanda ke biyan kuɗi fiye da kima kuma suna tambayar ku don dawo da kuɗin bambancin, ko aika hanyoyin biyan kuɗi suna neman PIN ko OTP na katin ku.
Koyaushe tabbatar da canja wuri a cikin app ɗin banki na ku, ba daga hoton allo ba.

panel.heading: Kare kanka daga zamba na biyan kuɗi

say: Don tunawa. Fara kowane bita tare da sakamakon da aka yarda, kuma ƙididdige matsalolin 0 zuwa 4 tare da shaida. Sanya ƙimar ranar ku akan burin ku da farashi, raba ta kwanaki masu ƙididdigewa.
Kula da rikodin azaman bayanan sirri. Kuma a cikin fayil ɗinku, nuna yanke shawara, ciniki da sakamakon da aka auna.

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Bincika wurin biyan kuɗi kai tsaye ko sigar sa hannu, farashin fakitin ku na farko tare da fom ɗin yarda, kuma gudanar da ɗan gajeren zargi yayin fara ma'ajiyar bincike.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
